title: Satya Nadella says all AI models should be assumed 'compromised', urges emergency brake
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella argued that advanced models must be assumed compromised and contained from the start, calling for a mandatory emergency brake and tamper-proof audit logs.
reason: Lab-leader policy signal favouring control measures. Original outlet (The Verge) cited via aggregator; direct link not captured.

title: Ukrainian drones knock out Yandex AI data centers housing its supercomputers
summary: Yandex suspended its Vladimir data center after a third Ukrainian drone strike in four days on its compute sites, which house supercomputers used to train its AI models.
reason: AI compute infrastructure becomes a direct military target in an active war.
